meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Philippines merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office created by the Philippine Statistical Act of 2013 (merger of NSO, NSCB, BLES, BAS). Produces censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, poverty and multi-domain statistics. Attached to NEDA for policy coordination.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the entire Philippine statistical system.

reports.title: Census of Population (and related mid-year estimates)
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. 2024 Census recorded 112,729,484 persons. Provides the demographic base for all per-capita and planning indicators.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~112.7 million (2024 Census).

reports.title: National Accounts of the Philippines (GDP / GRDP)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure) and Gross Regional Domestic Product. Central macro-output series.
_referenced_by: BSP Monetary Policy Report and economic assessments

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates by major commodity group and region. High-frequency price signal used in monetary policy and welfare analysis.
_referenced_by: BSP inflation targeting and Monetary Policy Report

reports.title: Labor Force Survey (LFS)
reports.description: Quarterly (and more frequent) labour-force statistics: employment, unemployment, underemployment, labour-force participation. Central labour-market barometer.

reports.title: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, external accounts and key macro-financial statistics. Publishes the Monetary Policy Report, Balance of Payments, International Reserves and related series.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
reports.description: Quarterly BOP and related external-sector accounts, including the large role of remittances (OFW) in the current account.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with strong remittance linkage — a defining Philippine feature.

reports.title: Gross International Reserves
reports.description: Monthly official reserve assets. Key external-buffer indicator expressed in months of import cover.

reports.title: Official poverty statistics (and related thresholds)
reports.description: Official poverty incidence, poverty thresholds and related indicators derived from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) and other sources. High policy salience.

reports.title: Philippines foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA and BSP sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the PSA institutional core, population census, national accounts, CPI, Labor Force Survey, BSP institutional role, BOP, international reserves and official poverty statistics into the opening foundation layer.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Philippine research.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Mining and quarrying production statistics
reports.publisher: Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR) / PSA related
reports.description: Official statistics on metallic and non-metallic mineral production. Nickel is the standout commodity (Philippines ranks among the world’s top producers); gold, copper and others complete the main metallic output.
reports._notes: Core mining statistical product. Nickel gives the Philippines a distinctive position in global battery/EV mineral supply chains.

reports.title: Nickel production and export statistics
reports.description: Focused statistics on nickel output and trade. The Philippines has been the second-ranked global producer in recent years, making nickel a high-centrality commodity node.
reports._notes: High-centrality commodity uniqueness node (parallel to Indonesian nickel but different institutional and policy context).

reports.title: Fisheries and aquaculture production statistics
reports.description: Official volume and value of production for capture fisheries and aquaculture (milkfish, tilapia and other species prominent). Complements the broader agriculture and food-security cluster.

reports.title: Port and shipping statistics (cargo, containers, passengers)
reports.description: Operational statistics on cargo throughput (MMT), container volume (TEUs), shipcalls and passenger traffic at Philippine ports. Captures both domestic inter-island and foreign trade flows.
reports._notes: Core maritime-logistics node for an archipelagic economy.

reports.title: Inter-island transport and connectivity framing
reports.publisher: Derived from PPA, transport and regional sources
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of inter-island shipping, passenger and cargo connectivity that links Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. Complements the ports statistics and the regional economic structure nodes.
reports._notes: Domestic-integration counterpart to the international trade and ports nodes.

reports.title: Philippines mining–fisheries–ports densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from MGB, PSA and PPA sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding mining/quarrying statistics, nickel production and trade, fisheries/aquaculture production, port/shipping operations and inter-island connectivity framing into a coherent resources–food–logistics layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier agriculture, trade, regional and external series

reports.title: MSME establishment and structure statistics
reports.description: Official counts and structure of micro, small and medium enterprises. MSMEs constitute the overwhelming majority of registered establishments (recently >99 %) and a large share of employment.
reports._notes: Core enterprise-structure node. Complements the formal manufacturing (ASPBI) and IT-BPM series.

reports.title: MSME development and financing policy framing
reports.description: Policy and programme framing around MSME support, credit guarantees, financing access and entrepreneurship promotion.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the MSME statistical node.

reports.title: Women and Men in the Philippines / Core GAD indicators
reports.description: Official gender statistics and Philippine Core Gender and Development (GAD) indicators covering population, education, health, labour, political participation and related domains.
_referenced_by: Labour Force Survey and OFW gender composition

reports.title: Housing and household characteristics statistics
reports.description: Housing stock, tenure, access to basic services and related household characteristics drawn from census and household surveys. Links to construction, urbanisation and welfare analysis.
reports._notes: Housing densification of the social and construction clusters.

reports.title: Philippines MSME–gender–housing densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA, DTI and related sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding MSME establishment and policy framing, Women and Men / GAD indicators, and housing/household characteristics into a coherent enterprise–gender–housing layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier labour, digital, construction and social series

reports.title: Department of National Defense / AFP budget statistics
reports.description: Official budget allocations for the Department of National Defense and the major services (Army, Navy, Air Force). Provides the resource base for defence and security analysis.

reports.title: Defence and security policy framing
reports.description: Recurring policy framing of Philippine defence and security priorities, including territorial defence, maritime security and internal security dimensions.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the defence budget node.

reports.title: Irrigation development and status statistics
reports.description: Official status of irrigation development — area irrigated, systems, and related indicators. Critical for rice production and agricultural resilience.

reports.title: Water resources and water-security framing
reports.publisher: Derived from NIA, DENR and planning sources
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of water resources, irrigation and water security that links agriculture, urban demand and climate resilience.

reports.title: Science, technology and R&D statistics
reports.publisher: Department of Science and Technology (DOST) / PSA related
reports.description: Official statistics on research and development expenditure, personnel and related S&T indicators. Provides the innovation and knowledge-generation base.

reports.title: Philippines defence–water–R&D densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from DND, NIA and DOST sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding defence budget and policy framing, irrigation development statistics, water-resources framing, and science/technology/R&D statistics into a coherent security–water–innovation layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier fiscal, agriculture, education and disaster series

reports.title: National Tax Allotment (NTA, formerly IRA) local government finance statistics
reports.description: The principal intergovernmental transfer (40% share of national internal revenue taxes) automatically released to provinces, cities, municipalities and barangays. Renamed National Tax Allotment following the Mandanas-Garcia ruling. Critical equalisation and local fiscal-capacity instrument.
reports._notes: Core subnational fiscal equalisation node (parallel to Indonesia’s DAU/DAK).

reports.title: Geothermal power capacity and generation statistics
reports.description: Installed and dependable geothermal capacity and related generation figures. The Philippines remains one of the world’s leading geothermal producers; geothermal forms a distinctive indigenous renewable component of the power mix.
_referenced_by: Philippine Power Statistics and energy-mix nodes

reports.title: Renewable energy project and capacity statistics (RE Act framework)
reports.description: Summary statistics on renewable-energy projects under the Renewable Energy Act of 2008 — hydropower, geothermal, wind, solar, biomass — covering potential and installed capacity.

reports.title: Philippine Development Plan (PDP) and NEDA planning framework
reports.description: The medium-term national development plan (current cycle 2023–2028) and associated progress reports. Provides the overarching policy and target frame that organises statistical monitoring across sectors.
_referenced_by: Almost all major statistical and programme series
Poverty, education, health and infrastructure targets

reports.title: Crime statistics (focus crimes and crime rate)
reports.description: Official focus-crime counts (murder, homicide, rape, physical injury, theft, robbery, vehicle theft) and overall crime-rate trends. Used in security and governance analysis.

reports.title: Port of Manila operational statistics
reports.description: Operational statistics for the country’s primary international container gateway (Manila International Container Terminal, South Harbor, North Harbor). Handles the large majority of international container trade.

reports.title: Port of Cebu operational statistics
reports.description: Operational statistics for the principal Visayas port hub — major domestic inter-island and secondary international gateway.

reports.title: Vital statistics (births, deaths, marriages)
reports.description: Registered births, deaths and marriages. Provides the continuous demographic flow data that complements the census and population projections.

reports.title: Public-Private Partnership / infrastructure investment framing
reports.description: Policy and project framing around public-private partnerships for infrastructure (transport, energy, water, etc.). Continuously cited in investment and fiscal discussions.

reports.title: BSP Monetary Policy Report
reports.description: Flagship periodic monetary-policy communication document that synthesises inflation, growth, external and financial conditions. High recurring-citation value across macro analysis.
_referenced_by: CPI, national accounts, BOP and reserves

reports.title: Subic–Clark special economic / freeport zone complex
reports.publisher: Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority / Clark Development Corporation / related
reports.description: Major freeport and special economic zone complex in Central Luzon (former US military bases). Complements the broader PEZA system with a distinctive logistics and industrial-location profile.

reports.title: Philippines final-densification meta-node (local fiscal–geothermal–PDP–crime–ports–vital)
reports.publisher: Derived from DBM, DOE, NEDA, PNP, PPA and PSA sources
reports.description: Closing meta-node binding National Tax Allotment, geothermal and renewable capacity, Philippine Development Plan, crime statistics, major ports (Manila, Cebu), vital statistics, PPP framing, BSP Monetary Policy Report and Subic–Clark freeport complex into the final ordinary-purpose densification layer.
reports._notes: Closing integrating node for the final densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier fiscal, energy, planning, security, ports and demographic series

reports.title: Overseas Filipino Workers stock and Survey on Overseas Filipinos
reports.description: Official estimates of the number of Overseas Filipino Workers (recently ~2.19 million) and related characteristics from the Survey on Overseas Filipinos. Captures both land-based and sea-based workers and the gender composition (female majority in recent rounds).
reports._notes: Core OFW stock node — one of the defining structural features of the Philippine economy and society.

reports.title: Overseas Filipino cash remittances (total and by country)
reports.description: High-frequency and annual statistics on cash remittances from overseas Filipinos, broken down by major source country. Remittances are a major stabilising component of the current account and household income.
reports._notes: High-centrality external and household-income node. Canada is a consistently ranked source country.

reports.title: Cash remittances from Canada
reports.description: BSP-reported cash remittances originating from Canada. Recent annual figures exceed USD 1.2 billion, placing Canada among the top source countries alongside the United States, Middle East destinations, Singapore, Japan and others.
reports._notes: Explicit Canada–Philippines financial linkage node. Reflects the large Filipino diaspora in Canada (including communities where Tagalog ranks as a major non-official language).
_referenced_by: Canada–Philippines migration and labour cooperation nodes

reports.title: Department of Migrant Workers institutional role and deployment statistics
reports.description: Lead agency for overseas employment policy, contract processing and worker protection. Publishes deployment / contracts-processed statistics by destination, sex and type (land-based, sea-based, new hires, rehires).
reports._notes: Policy and administrative counterpart to the statistical OFW nodes.

reports.title: Philippines–Canada labour and migration cooperation framework
reports.publisher: Department of Migrant Workers (PH) / Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada
reports.description: Joint Declaration of Intent (signed Vancouver, July 2026) and related instruments on ethical recruitment, labour rights and migration cooperation. Formalises the policy channel that underpins the large bilateral labour flow.
reports._notes: Key bilateral policy node linking the statistical remittance flow to formal labour-migration governance.

reports.title: Canada–Philippines trade, defence and broader partnership framework
reports.publisher: Governments of Canada and the Philippines
reports.description: Evolving bilateral architecture including planned free-trade agreement, defence cooperation, energy and other sectoral understandings. Complements the labour-migration channel.
reports._notes: Wider Canada partnership node beyond pure labour flows.

reports.title: Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES)
reports.description: Major household survey providing income, expenditure and inequality data. Primary source for official poverty statistics and for understanding the household-level impact of remittances.
reports._notes: Household-income densification that links remittances to welfare outcomes.

reports.title: Underemployment and quality-of-employment indicators (LFS)
reports.description: Underemployment rates and related quality-of-employment measures from the Labor Force Survey. Complements the headline unemployment rate and is relevant to the push factors behind overseas work.
reports._notes: Labour-quality node that helps explain the scale of the OFW phenomenon.

reports.title: Philippines OFW–remittance–Canada densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA, BSP, DMW and bilateral sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding OFW stock, total and Canada-specific remittances, DMW institutional role, Philippines–Canada labour/migration cooperation, broader Canada partnership, FIES household income/expenditure, and underemployment indicators into a coherent migration–remittance–Canada cluster.
reports._notes: High-centrality integrating node for the defining OFW/remittance feature and the Canada linkage requested by the user.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
BOP, poverty and labour series from Batch 1

reports.title: IT-BPM / BPO industry statistics and performance
reports.description: Industry statistics on the Information Technology and Business Process Management sector — revenues (recently ~USD 40+ billion), headcount (~1.8–1.9 million FTEs), global market share, and sub-sector composition (customer experience, healthcare, IT services, etc.). Philippines ranks as the world’s second-largest IT-BPM delivery geography after India.
reports._notes: High-centrality uniqueness node. Alongside OFW remittances, IT-BPM is a defining export of Philippine services and human capital.
_referenced_by: Labour Force Survey and employment analysis

reports.title: IT-BPM policy and investment-promotion framing
reports.description: Policy and investment-promotion framing that treats IT-BPM as a strategic growth sector, including incentives, talent development and the push toward higher-value / AI-augmented services.
reports._notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the industry performance node.

reports.title: National Capital Region (NCR) Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for the National Capital Region — the dominant services and administrative core of the Philippine economy.

reports.title: CALABARZON Gross Regional Domestic Product
reports.description: Official GRDP for CALABARZON — major industrial and manufacturing belt adjacent to NCR, frequently accounting for a large share of national industry output and ranking among the largest regional economies.
reports._notes: Primary industrial-belt regional output node. Together with NCR forms the Luzon economic core.

reports.title: Philippine regional economic structure (Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao)
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA GRDP and related series
reports.description: System-level view of the three major island-group economies and the concentration of output in Luzon (especially NCR + CALABARZON). Provides the spatial organising frame for later provincial densification.

reports.title: Agriculture and fisheries production statistics
reports.description: Official value and volume of production in agriculture and fisheries. Crops (especially rice/palay) dominate; livestock, poultry and fisheries complete the sector.

reports.title: Rice / palay production statistics
reports.description: Official palay (unmilled rice) production volume and related indicators. Rice remains the central food-security crop and a politically sensitive commodity; weather, irrigation and import policy strongly affect outcomes.
_referenced_by: CPI food component and inflation analysis

reports.title: Philippines IT-BPM–regional–agriculture densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from IBPAP/IBOB, PSA GRDP and agriculture sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding IT-BPM industry performance and policy framing, NCR and CALABARZON GRDP, broader Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao regional structure, agriculture/fisheries production, and rice/palay statistics into a coherent services-export, spatial-concentration and food-security layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, labour and poverty series from earlier batches

reports.title: NDRRMC – National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
reports.publisher: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
reports.description: Lead coordinating body for disaster risk reduction and management. Issues situational reports and compiles impact data on tropical cyclones, earthquakes and other hazards.
reports._notes: Institutional core of the Philippine disaster-management system.

reports.title: Natural hazard occurrence and impact statistics (typhoons, earthquakes, etc.)
reports.description: Compiled statistics on fatalities, injuries, affected population, damaged houses and economic losses from tropical cyclones, earthquakes and other natural hazards. Typhoons are the dominant recurring high-impact hazard.
reports._notes: Core multi-hazard impact series. The Philippines lies on both the typhoon belt and the Pacific Ring of Fire.

reports.title: PAGASA tropical cyclone and weather monitoring products
reports.description: Official meteorological agency products on tropical cyclones, rainfall and related hazards. Provides the scientific monitoring backbone for NDRRMC response and early warning.
reports._notes: Meteorological monitoring node tightly coupled to the disaster cluster.

reports.title: PEZA ecozone and investment statistics
reports.description: Statistics on approved investments, employment generation, number of ecozones and export performance under the PEZA regime. Ecozones are a principal vehicle for manufacturing and IT-BPM location.
reports._notes: Key special-zone and investment-promotion node. Complements the IT-BPM cluster.

reports.title: Merchandise trade by major partner country
reports.description: Export and import values by principal trading partners. United States, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Korea and ASEAN partners recur as leading markets and sources; electronics dominate the commodity mix.
reports._notes: Partner-side densification of the external-trade cluster.
_referenced_by: National accounts and BOP goods account

reports.title: Electronics and semiconductor trade statistics
reports.description: Trade statistics focused on electronic products — the single largest merchandise export category and a major import category as well, reflecting the country’s role in regional electronics value chains.
reports._notes: Commodity-specific trade node that links the Philippines into East Asian electronics networks.

reports.title: Philippines disaster–PEZA–trade densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from NDRRMC, PEZA and PSA trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding NDRRMC, disaster impact statistics, PAGASA monitoring, PEZA ecozone/investment performance, merchandise trade by partner, and electronics trade into a coherent risk–investment–trade layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier regional, IT-BPM and external-sector series

reports.title: Philippine Power Statistics (generation, capacity, consumption)
reports.description: Official statistics on installed and dependable capacity, gross generation by technology, electricity sales and consumption, and system peak demand. Coal remains the largest single source; natural gas, geothermal, hydro, solar, wind and oil-based plants complete the mix. Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao grids reported separately.
reports._notes: Core power-system statistical product. Coal-dominant with significant renewable (especially geothermal) contribution.
_referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy analysis

reports.title: Electricity generation and capacity mix by technology
reports.description: Breakdown of installed/dependable capacity and generation by fuel/technology — coal, natural gas, oil-based, geothermal, hydro, solar, wind, biomass, storage. Highlights both the coal lock-in and the sizeable indigenous geothermal resource.

reports.title: Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) statistics
reports.publisher: Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)
reports.description: Official performance and coverage statistics for the national conditional cash-transfer and human-capital program. Tracks household beneficiaries, self-sufficiency exits, education and health outcomes of monitored children.
reports._notes: Flagship social-protection node. Institutionalised by RA 11310.

reports.title: Broader social-protection and human-capital programme framing
reports.description: Policy and statistical framing of the wider social-protection system that centres 4Ps while encompassing complementary programmes for food security, health and shock response.

reports.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Philippine participation)
reports.publisher: ASEAN / Department of Trade and Industry
reports.description: Philippine participation in the ASEAN economic community and related cooperation frameworks. Continuously cited in regional trade, investment and policy analysis.

reports.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) participation
reports.description: Philippine membership in RCEP — the mega-FTA linking ASEAN with China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand. Provides preferential market access and rules that interact with electronics and other supply-chain trade.

reports.title: Philippines energy–social-protection–ASEAN densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from DOE, DSWD and DTI/ASEAN sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Philippine Power Statistics, electricity generation/capacity mix, 4Ps programme statistics, broader social-protection framing, ASEAN cooperation and RCEP participation into a coherent energy, welfare and regional-architecture layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier poverty, trade and national-accounts series

reports.title: Higher education statistics (enrolment, institutions, graduates)
reports.publisher: Commission on Higher Education (CHED) / PSA related
reports.description: Official statistics on higher-education institutions, enrolment, graduates and faculty. Provides the human-capital supply side that feeds both the domestic labour market and the OFW / IT-BPM talent pipelines.
_referenced_by: Labor Force Survey and skills analysis

reports.title: Basic education statistics (DepEd)
reports.description: Enrolment, completion and related indicators for elementary and secondary education. Complements the higher-education series and links to 4Ps education conditions.

reports.title: PhilHealth coverage and claims statistics
reports.description: Membership, coverage, claims and financial performance statistics of the national health-insurance programme. Central instrument of health financing and universal-health-coverage policy.

reports.title: Key health and nutrition indicators
reports.description: Official indicators on child nutrition (stunting, wasting, underweight), vaccination, maternal care, mortality and leading causes of death. Provides the outcome side of the health system.

reports.title: BARMM (Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao) economic and statistical profile
reports.description: Regional accounts, growth and sectoral performance for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region. Captures the distinctive political-economy and development trajectory of the autonomous region within Mindanao.
reports._notes: Key autonomous-region node. Distinct institutional and development path inside the Philippine archipelago.

reports.title: Mindanao regional economic profile
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA GRDP and related regional series
reports.description: System-level view of Mindanao’s economic structure — agriculture-heavy in many areas, with distinct growth patterns, resource endowments and the special case of BARMM. Complements the Luzon-core concentration nodes.

reports.title: Philippines education–health–Mindanao densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from CHED, DepEd, PhilHealth, PSA and BARMM sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding higher-education statistics, basic-education indicators, PhilHealth coverage, key health/nutrition outcomes, BARMM economic profile and broader Mindanao regional structure into a coherent human-capital and southern-spatial layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier 4Ps, labour, regional and poverty series

reports.title: National Government fiscal operations and budget statistics
reports.publisher: Department of Budget and Management / Bureau of the Treasury
reports.description: Official statistics on national government revenues, expenditures, financing and fiscal balance. Core public-finance series used in macro and debt analysis.

reports.title: National Government outstanding debt statistics
reports.description: Outstanding domestic and external debt of the national government, with periodic updates on composition and ratios. High-visibility macro-fiscal indicator.

reports.title: Annual Survey of Philippine Business and Industry – Manufacturing
reports.description: Detailed structural statistics on manufacturing establishments, employment, revenue and expenses from the ASPBI. Complements the national-accounts manufacturing GVA series.

reports.title: Tourism statistics (arrivals, receipts, TDGVA)
reports.description: International visitor arrivals, tourism receipts and Tourism Direct Gross Value Added. Captures both foreign tourists and returning overseas Filipinos (balikbayans).
reports._notes: Core tourism statistical product. Canada appears among notable source markets.

reports.title: Philippine financial system resources and structure
reports.description: Total resources of banks and non-bank financial institutions, with breakdowns by universal/commercial, thrift, digital, rural/cooperative banks and NBFIs. Provides the size and structure of the formal financial system.
reports._notes: Core financial-system size and structure node.

reports.title: Construction statistics and GVA
reports.description: Construction-sector output, employment and related indicators. Important cyclical and investment-related series.
reports._notes: Construction densification of the industry cluster.

reports.title: Gross Fixed Capital Formation statistics
reports.description: Investment-side national-accounts series covering construction, durable equipment and other capital formation. Links fiscal, private investment and growth analysis.

reports.title: CPI by major commodity group and regional inflation
reports.description: Detailed CPI breakdowns (food, housing, transport, etc.) and regional inflation rates that complement the headline CPI series.
_referenced_by: Headline CPI and BSP inflation targeting

reports.title: Visayas regional economic profile
reports.description: System-level view of the Visayas island-group economy, completing the Luzon–Visayas–Mindanao spatial triad.

reports.title: Philippines fiscal–manufacturing–tourism–finance densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from DBM, BTr, PSA, DOT and BSP sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding national fiscal operations, government debt, manufacturing ASPBI, tourism statistics, financial-system resources, construction, GFCF, detailed CPI and Visayas regional structure into a denser multi-domain layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier macro, regional and external series

reports.title: Philippine Digital Economy Satellite Account (PDESA)
reports.description: Official satellite account measuring the size and contribution of the digital economy (digital infrastructure, e-commerce, digital content/media, government digital services). Recent figures put digital GVA around 9–10 % of GDP and employment in the tens of millions.
reports._notes: High-value digital-economy measurement node. Complements the IT-BPM industry statistics.

reports.title: E-commerce component of the digital economy
reports.description: E-commerce share of digital-economy output and especially employment (largest employment component in recent PDESA releases).

reports.title: External debt statistics
reports.description: Outstanding external debt (public and private), by creditor type and maturity. Complements the national-government debt series and the BOP/IIP.
reports._notes: External-debt densification of the external-sector cluster.

reports.title: Governance and anti-corruption policy framing
reports.publisher: Government of the Philippines / related oversight bodies
reports.description: Recurring policy and public-debate framing around corruption, accountability and governance quality. Continuously referenced in fiscal, infrastructure and investment discussions (including high-profile flood-control and public-works issues).
reports._notes: Governance-frame node. Complements the statistical fiscal and disaster clusters.

reports.title: Oversight institutions (Ombudsman, Commission on Audit) institutional role
reports.publisher: Office of the Ombudsman / Commission on Audit
reports.description: Constitutional and statutory oversight bodies responsible for accountability, audit and anti-graft functions. Continuously cited in governance and public-finance integrity analysis.

reports.title: Monetary aggregates and banking statistics
reports.description: Money supply, credit and related banking indicators that complement the financial-system resources series and feed monetary-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Monetary densification of the central-bank cluster.

reports.title: International Investment Position
reports.description: Stock measure of external financial assets and liabilities. Complements the flow BOP and the external-debt series.

reports.title: Philippines digital–external-debt–governance densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from PSA, BSP and governance sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the Digital Economy Satellite Account, e-commerce component, external debt, International Investment Position, monetary aggregates, governance/anti-corruption framing and oversight institutions into a denser digital–external–governance layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier BOP, fiscal, IT-BPM and financial-system series

reports.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
reports.publisher: Government of the Philippines / Climate Change Commission related
reports.description: Philippine NDC under the Paris Agreement, targeting substantial GHG reduction relative to business-as-usual. Continuously cited in energy, transport, agriculture and LULUCF policy discussions.

reports.title: Greenhouse gas inventory and emissions statistics
reports.description: National GHG inventory results by sector (energy dominant; LULUCF as net sink). Provides the empirical base for NDC tracking.

reports.title: Forest cover and forestry sector statistics
reports.publisher: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) / PSA related
reports.description: Land classification, forest cover, production/protection forest, and related forestry production and management statistics. Forests are treated as a net carbon sink in the NDC.

reports.title: Philippines–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (PJEPA)
reports.publisher: Governments of the Philippines and Japan
reports.description: Long-standing bilateral EPA with Japan (in force since 2008). Covers goods, services, investment and movement of natural persons; continuously relevant to electronics, automotive and labour flows.
reports._notes: Foundational bilateral EPA node with Japan.

reports.title: Philippines–Korea Free Trade Agreement (PH-ROK FTA)
reports.publisher: Governments of the Philippines and Republic of Korea
reports.description: Bilateral FTA that entered into force end-2024. Provides deeper preferential access than existing ASEAN-Korea and RCEP schedules in priority products and includes economic-cooperation chapters.

reports.title: Philippines–EFTA Free Trade Agreement
reports.description: Bilateral FTA with the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), in force since 2018.

reports.title: Population projections
reports.description: Official population projections (recently to 2035, with national total approaching ~124 million). Provides the forward demographic frame for planning, labour and social-protection analysis.

reports.title: Philippine FTA / EPA network overview
reports.publisher: Department of Trade and Industry / derived
reports.description: System-level view of the Philippines’ active free-trade and economic-partnership agreements (ASEAN, RCEP, PJEPA, PH-ROK, PH-EFTA, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes.

reports.title: Philippines climate–FTA–demography densification meta-node

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
